nl: In web.config, set the debug attribute of compilation to "false". Keep the rest of the document unchanged.

entries.content_utf8:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<configuration>
  <appSettings>
    <add key="Environment" value="Staging" />
    <add key="CacheMinutes" value="10" />
  </appSettings>
  <system.web><compilation debug="true" /></system.web>
</configuration>

web.config.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<configuration>
  <appSettings>
    <add key="Environment" value="Staging" />
    <add key="CacheMinutes" value="10" />
  </appSettings>
  <system.web><compilation debug="false" /></system.web>
</configuration>
